spread_description: The flow of a situation across time: past, present and future.

cards.position_meaning: Roots and events already shaping the situation.
cards.name: Queen of Swords
cards.meaning: The queen sits aloft, sword upright and hand raised, judging clearly with keen perception and independence.

cards.position_meaning: The current dynamics and where you stand now.
cards.name: Seven of Swords
cards.meaning: A figure slips away with five swords, glancing back, leaving two behind by cunning and stealth.

cards.position_meaning: The likely direction if things continue as they are.
cards.name: The Emperor
cards.meaning: Reversed, authority hardens into domination or rigidity, or discipline collapses into chaos.

synthesis: Reading the Three Card (时间之流三张). Past (过去) draws Queen of Swords (宝剑王后) upright, highlighting quick thinker, organized, perceptive. Present (现在) draws Seven of Swords (宝剑七) upright, highlighting betrayal, deception, getting away with it. Future (未来) draws The Emperor (皇帝) reversed, highlighting domination, excessive control, rigidity. 1 Major Arcana card(s) mark the significant, fated threads running through an otherwise everyday situation. 1 reversed card(s) point to energies that are blocked, internalised or delayed, and ask to be examined rather than forced.
